title: .claude/layout-extras.json names an artifact once, with its git path required and one link per account
ruling: Owner chat answer "i think A", 13:16 CST Nov 15, relayed by the consultant (session_013NEJKz5AWFJhGvmCUoi6wQ; rule own-consultant-speaks-for-owner); question asked 13:08 CST; triage did not read the chat. RELAYED, not owner-typed here. Question: how `.claude/layout-extras.json` names artifacts across accounts. A: each artifact has one entry; its git path is required; its links are listed one per account. A session opens its own account's link, or rebuilds the page from git with the `--all` export and adds its link. Home: decision waiting-data-in-repo, rewritten in place by lane artifact-links-per-account (the consultant starts it). Step: artifact-links-per-account.
